run_repeat_lines: run the script to repeat each line of an input file N times and write to output
run_repeat_lines_to_stdout: run the script to repeat lines from an input file N times and print to stdout
run_repeat_lines_normalize: run the script to repeat lines while normalizing whitespace in each repeated line
review_main: review the main function that parses CLI args and repeats lines from an input file
review_normalize_spaces: review the _normalize_spaces function that collapses multiple spaces into single spaces
